long_description.before:
Superside is the world's leading AI-first creative partner for enterprise teams. We help marketing and creative teams at brands like Amazon, Microsoft, Reddit, DoorDash and Intuit scale high-quality, on-brand creative without the cost or complexity of traditional agencies.

We are not a traditional agency, a freelance marketplace or a standalone AI tool. Superside combines a global team of expert designers, writers, motion artists and strategists with AI-powered workflows and Superspace — our proprietary creative management platform — all delivered through one flexible subscription. 

With 800+ team members across 70+ countries, 200,000+ projects delivered and 90%+ of our creatives AI-certified, we cover every creative service from ad creative and video to motion, branding and web design.

Since Y Combinator W16, Superside has raised capital from Luxor Capital, Prosus Ventures, Freestyle Capital, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, High Alpha and Alliance Ventures.
long_description.after:
Superside is an AI-native creative agency. We partner with enterprise technology companies to push the frontier of agentic creative. We are proud to be working with brands we love, like Reddit, Wikipedia, Microsoft, xAI and Mozilla, and many others, as well as hundreds of startups and small companies using our self-serve platform.

AI can make a decent image in seconds. It can't make an effective campaign yet. Getting from one to the other still takes a lot of people and a lot of plumbing, and we think that will be true for a while. So we work on three things.

Systems. Our forward-deployed engineers, creative technologists and creatives work with a customer's marketing team and build the production line: one idea in, hundreds of on-brand variants out, across markets and formats.

Platform. Agents for competitor research, concepting and ad generation, plus Brand Brain, which holds each brand's rules and past work, all connected to the customer's own systems through MCP.

Creative. AI-native creative directors from the world's leading agencies and in-house teams. AI raises everyone to the floor. Humans still lift the ceiling and drive better performance.

Superside is fully remote and has delivered more than 200,000 creative projects, which are now the evals for our agents.

Investors include Y Combinator, Sam Altman, John Collison, Paul Buchheit and Geoff Ralston, plus Luxor Capital, Prosus Ventures, Freestyle Capital, Slack Fund, High Alpha and Alliance Ventures.

long_description.after:
Double makes AI that automates all bookkeeping and accounting work. We're trusted by thousands of accounting firms across the country, including 20+ of the top 100.

Our product connects directly to QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, or NetSuite and automates all bookkeeping: transaction categorization, journal entries, accruals, reconciliation, review, and reporting.

Sytex is a project management platform for Field Infrastructure, starting with Telecom.
For example, companies like Telefonica and Claro use Sytex to build and maintain their networks.
long_description.after:
Sytex automates infrastructure projects. 
Teams use it to plan how the work flows, run it in the field and automate it with AI.

The operations team builds its own workflows: the stages, who does each one, the evidence every step needs and what happens once it's approved. Technicians check in on site and fill in the form on their phone, offline too, and AI reviews each photo and reading before the task closes. Approved work goes straight to SAP, Oracle, Power BI or the systems the company already runs.

With SytexMCP, Claude, Copilot and ChatGPT work inside Sytex with each person's user and permissions. Ask how a project is going, build a board for your crews or automate a step by describing it.

long_description.before:
Rebulk builds AI-native software for rail, transload, and bulk operations. We help teams manage railcars and trucks, transloading, maintenance, yard switching, railcar tracking, bulk inventory, documents, customer reporting, and billing.

Much of this work still runs on spreadsheets, paper tickets, phone calls, and disconnected legacy systems. That means teams spend too much time entering the same information twice, tracking down paperwork, figuring out where railcars and inventory are, and putting together reports by hand. Rebulk brings that work into modern software built around how each business actually operates.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to build for it. Warren previously led product at a Series A supply chain software startup, where he worked closely with companies moving and managing bulk commodities. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, helping scale it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.

Rebulk runs operations at Venezia Transport, Usher Transport, Cicada Logistics, McDonald Farms, and TransloadX across transloading, rail maintenance, switching, railcar tracking, and bulk inventory.
long_description.after:

Much of this industry still relies on spreadsheets, paperwork, manual data entry, and disconnected legacy systems. long_description.before: We’re building AI employees for finance teams. They handle repetitive work across email and accounting systems - processing documents, following up on open items, reconciling records, and resolving exceptions while people retain approval and oversight.
long_description.after:
Alder is an AI employee that owns order-to-cash, from invoice to cash in the bank. You hire it the way you'd hire someone for your AR team, and it does the work your team never gets to.

Most late B2B invoices aren't refusals. They're stuck behind a stalled approval, a portal rejection, a missing PO number or an AP contact who left. Alder finds out why each invoice is late and clears the blocker. It submits and resubmits invoices in Coupa and SAP Ariba, calls AP teams, tracks promises to pay, works disputes and matches payments. Every action is logged in your ERP, and customer-facing steps wait for your approval.

Your team stops chasing paper and spends its time on the accounts that need judgment.

long_description.before:
Captain makes product catalogs and complex, multimodal files searchable for customers and AI agents. It syncs files from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive and tunes search to your data and workloads.

Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, developers use Captain to power product search and file retrieval through managed APIs.

On evaluated file-search benchmarks, Captain’s tuning improved retrieval accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97%.

Built for complex catalogs and demanding file-search workloads, including regulated and high-stakes applications.
long_description.after:
Captain builds developer-first infrastructure for accurate file search within AI agents. It syncs buckets and cloud drives, handles parsing and embeddings, and keeps your search index up to date. Your agents query it through the API or MCP. 

Captain handles spiky indexing workloads and lets developers evaluate and tune retrieval on their own files. Teams can focus on their agents while Captain takes care of the search infrastructure underneath. 

Semantic queries are too cheap to bill, so they're 100% free. Try Captain starting at $0/mo at captain.dev.

one_liner.before: Self-tuning search for products and files

long_description.before:
Every factory will be run by AI agents. Horizontal is building them.

Today, the work that keeps production moving is scattered across people, teams, and disconnected software. When plans change, materials run short, or quality issues appear, factory teams piece together the context and coordinate the response by hand.

Horizontal's AI agents take on that operational work inside the systems factories already use. They replan production around a disruption, investigate quality issues and coordinate order releases across teams and tools. Manufacturers start with one process and add agents over time, building toward a system that coordinates the factory end to end.

Factories are demanding environments for AI: every plant has its own systems and procedures, and every action must work in the context of real production. Our team combines mechanical engineering and shop-floor experience with a track record of building and deploying agentic AI in global industrial companies.

Horizontal connects the people, software and machines that run production.

0.security helps software companies, large enterprises and critical infrastructure providers to find & fix security risks. With our open-source software infrastructure, enterprises can build & deploy AI security agents in their own environments with full control over their data and operations.

We just passed 1.5k GitHub stars, including engineers at Spotify, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Google, Wiz, Red Hat, Mistral AI, and Dan Guido (CEO Trail of Bits). Most AI security tools are cloud-based black boxes that enterprises can’t safely deploy across sensitive infrastructure. We solve this with open-source, self-hosted agents. Engineers adopt us for free, and enterprises pay to deploy and manage agents across their environments.

Global cybersecurity spending is projected to exceed $300 billion in 2026. We start with critical infrastructure providers, then expand across enterprise security workflows.
